message.content: {"note_claim": "Iran has been experiencing a widespread internet blackout since January 8, 2026, lasting over 100 days, limiting most citizens' access to the global internet and digital services.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Pezeshkian's move to review the government's internet policy comes 11 weeks into a near-total online blackout affecting 90 million-plus citizens, which followed a similar 20-day outage during deadly nationwide protests in January.", "reason": "The article confirms a near-total online blackout affecting 90 million-plus citizens, following a January outage, and describes it as the longest nationwide internet shutdown in the world, directly substantiating the note's claim of a widespread, prolonged internet blackout limiting citizens' access."}

parsed.note_claim: Iran has been experiencing a widespread internet blackout since January 8, 2026, lasting over 100 days, limiting most citizens' access to the global internet and digital services.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Pezeshkian's move to review the government's internet policy comes 11 weeks into a near-total online blackout affecting 90 million-plus citizens, which followed a similar 20-day outage during deadly nationwide protests in January.
parsed.reason: The article confirms a near-total online blackout affecting 90 million-plus citizens, following a January outage, and describes it as the longest nationwide internet shutdown in the world, directly substantiating the note's claim of a widespread, prolonged internet blackout limiting citizens' access.
